test_verify: test the PyTorch model export to ONNX and verify functional equivalence using ONNX Runtime
test_find_mismatch: test the PyTorch model to find minimal subgraph exhibiting mismatch between TorchScript and ONNX exports
test_verify_aten_graph: test the TorchScript IR graph export to ONNX and verify output equivalence
test_check_export_model_diff: test the exported model graph discrepancy across different groups of test inputs
create_graph_info: create a GraphInfo object containing validation information of a TorchScript graph and its converted ONNX graph
